title: TDlive chart (Michael Kramer's three-concentric-circle notation, as data)
description: One tune. The three top-level blocks mirror the three circles: rhythm = outer circle, pitch = middle circle, form = inner circle. `changes` is the optional bar-by-bar timeline the live system follows. See docs/NOTATION.md.

spelled.description: A spelled pitch class: letter + accidentals (# or b). Spelling matters (palette colours follow spelling). 'F#/Gb' = spelling not decided yet.

status.description: sketch = notation only; playable = has `changes` complete enough to follow live.

changes_notation.description: absolute = chord symbols ('Ab7'); roman = numerals relative to the MAJOR scale of the key ('bVI7'), spelled when a key is chosen (default_key, or picked at rehearsal/performance).

default_key.description: Key used when none is picked live, e.g. 'F' or 'Bb'. Spelled like a key signature.

rhythm.description: OUTER circle: pulse, feel, emphases. The inner polygon has one side per beat of the bar.

accents.description: Emphasis nodes ('balls') on the polygon: 1-based beat positions; fractions mark off-beats (2.5 = the 'and' of 2).

pitch.description: MIDDLE circle: the circle of fifths (C at the top, clockwise G, D, A ...).

melodic_nodes.description: Highlighted pitch nodes on the circle (the melody's important notes).

harmonies.description: Harmony circles. Inside the middle circle = minor, outside = major. Each is itself a circle of fifths; the polygon inside it shows the chord's interval structure.

tones.description: Chord tones as spelled pitches, root first (the polygon's corners).

form.description: INNER circle: form as groupings of bars. Shape sides x zig-zag multiplier = bars; hashes = repeats.

shape.description: Sides of the shape = bars in the grouping (square = 4, octagon = 8).

multiplier.description: Zig-zag inside the shape: multiply the grouping (square with a 3-stroke zig-zag = 12 bars).

hashes.description: Hash marks = times the section is repeated. Played (hashes + 1) times.

order.description: Optional explicit play order by section name (default: each section in turn, repeats played back to back).

changes.description: Optional timeline for the live system: per section, a list of bars; each bar is a list of chords as [symbol, beats]. Chord roots must be spelled (they choose the colour). With changes_notation 'roman', symbols are numerals (I7, ii-7, #IVo7, bVI7).
